text: But it starts with S E O. Search Engine Optimization.
It's how your website shows up higher in organic, unpaid search results.
S E O brings more traffic, visibility, leads and conversions.
Search engines crawl, index, then rank your pages.
And there are six types of S E O.
On-page: optimizing your content and page elements.
Technical: making your site fast, crawlable and indexable.
Off-page: building authority through backlinks and P R.
International: targeting multiple countries and languages.
And e-commerce: optimizing products and categories.
Because S E O isn't just about rankings.
It's about helping users find the right answers.
